hooks.command: payload="$(cat)"; if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then file=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); else file=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | grep -o '"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed -E 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([^"]*)"/\1/'); fi; case "$file" in *.ts|*.js) npm run -s typecheck || true ;; esac; exit 0
